demonstrates: Found a silent correctness defect in my own training pipeline where three individually-correct decisions compose into reporting a test score for a model that is never shipped, fixed it by reloading the selected weights from disk before scoring, and confirmed both branches of the fix on real cluster runs rather than in isolated unit tests.

claims.note: Epoch of the last validation improvement, whose loss the manifest reports as best_val_loss.
Epochs actually run; 18, 19 and 20 were all worse, so the resident model that got scored was not the selected one.
